# Load data

```{r}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(lme4)
library(visreg)

#read in data
data <- read.csv("06_cleandata/combined_plot_data.csv")

#filter data to only include within field data
field_data <- data %>%
  filter(plot_id != "d")
```

# Practice plotting data to see if data frame is set up correctly

```{r}


#number NSQ vs % bare ground
ggplot(field_data, aes(x = nest_searching_queens, y = bare_avg)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Bumble Bees vs. % Bare Ground",
       x = "NSQ",
       y = "% bare") +
  theme_minimal()

```
